title: A Way Out
summary: Reeve Halden knows what you've been growing. He also knows you've been doing good lately. He's offering one way out.

goals.say: 'I won't pretend I'm not disappointed. But you came back. Let's finish this properly.'
goals.name: Reeve Halden

quest_book.title: A Way Out
quest_book.author: Reeve Halden
pages:
I know about the fields.

I also know about the things you've done since. People talk about both.

Come and see me. There's a way out of the Blackwater trade that doesn't end in a ditch. It will cost you your fields and your profit, and it will be worth it.

- Halden

threats.name: Reeve Halden
threats.target_line: 'I won't pretend I'm not disappointed. But you came back. Let's finish this properly.'
talk: Reeve of Ashford. What's left of it. You're the one Mara writes about.
Everyone knows Old Mara. Nobody knows where she lives.
